title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kpatch-patch-5_14_0-427_100_1, kpatch-patch-5_14_0-427_113_1,…
description: This advisory addresses multiple security vulnerabilities in the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.4 kernel live patch module for kernel-5.14.0-427.100.1.el9_4. The vulnerabilities include improper validation of DAC offset in SMB client, improper allocation limits in IPC, a potential use-after-free in UDP tunnel segmentation, and unbounded receive headroom in the network tunnel driver. These issues have been fixed in updated kpatch-patch packages.
